summary: Fetches unpinned remote JavaScript from unpkg.com and executes it via eval() on import and CLI startup
details: src/use-m-bootstrap.lib.mjs defines USE_M_BOOTSTRAP_URL = 'https://unpkg.com/use-m/use.js' (unpinned/latest) and calls eval() on the fetched response body. This bootstrap is invoked unconditionally at module top level in src/models/index.mjs, which is reached transitively when a consumer imports the declared main (src/hive.mjs → src/hive.config.lib.mjs → src/models/index.mjs) and is also invoked whenever any of the package's bin CLIs runs. The resulting loader is subsequently used to run `npm install -g <alias>@latest` for numerous packages resolved at runtime. Because the primary fetch URL is unpinned and the fallback also resolves through a third-party mutable registry mirror, the JavaScript executed on the installer's Node process is determined out-of-band from package.json / lockfiles and can change between invocations. Whoever controls the use-m package on npm or the unpkg CDN response at fetch time can substitute arbitrary code that then runs in the consumer's Node process on every require/import and every CLI invocation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
